1. **Request:** Two infra-view changes — make the container "Inspect" action behave like "Logs" (open the detail overlay on a tab, not a dialog), and add a "Maintenance" section for detecting/removing/pruning old resources.
2. **Inspect fix:** Added an `inspect` tab to `ContainerDrawer.vue` (`DRAWER_TABS`, header button now switches tabs with active state) with a full-height JSON pane plus Reload and Copy JSON; `ContainersPanel.vue` buttons now call `openContainer(c.id, 'inspect')` while `openContainer()` in `useInfra.js` re-asserts the tab before and after the detail fetch.
3. **Maintenance panel:** Created `MaintenancePanel.vue` with an age-threshold selector, Rescan, quick prune targets, per-group review lists (select-all, bulk and single removal) and an empty state; added the `maintenance` tab to `TABS`, `tabCount`, and `InfraView.vue` (shared filter row hidden for that route).

# codx-junior UI — Features & Functionality Guide

**codx-junior** is an AI-powered development workspace. It brings your projects,
chats with AI assistants, task boards, documentation, knowledge search, code
review, team collaboration and analytics together in a single application.

This guide is written **for end users**. It explains *what you can do* and *why
it matters*, grouped by topic. No technical or installation details are covered
here — only the features you will see and use.

---

## Table of contents

1. [Getting around the app](#getting-around-the-app)
2. [Projects](#projects)

## Getting around the app

codx-junior adapts to the device you are using and gives you two ways to work:

- **Desktop mode** — a flexible workspace where several apps stay open at the
  same time as side-by-side **panels** (like windows).
- **Single mode** — a focused, one-app-at-a-time experience used on smaller
  screens and mobile.

### The sidebar

The left sidebar is your main launcher. It gives quick access to your projects,
recent chats, tasks and the most used apps.

- **Collapse / expand** the sidebar to gain screen space.
- On **mobile** the sidebar slides in as an overlay and closes automatically when
  you navigate away.

### Main menu & command palette

- The **Menu** button opens the full application menu (projects, views,
  workspaces, settings and every app).
- **Top bar search / command palette** (shortcut **⌘K**) lets you jump straight
  to a project, chat or command without hunting through menus.

> **Tip:** In desktop mode you can open the same app several times (for example,
> one Task Manager per board) and arrange them however you like. In single mode,
> opening an app replaces the current one.

---

## Projects

A **project** is the unit everything else revolves around — chats, tasks,
knowledge, wiki and analytics all belong to a project.

### Working with multiple projects

- **Switch projects** at any time from the project selector, sidebar or menu.
- The address bar always reflects which project you are working in, so you can
  bookmark or refresh a page and stay in the same project.
- **Recent projects** are remembered, and you can **pin** your favourite projects
  for one-click switching.

### Project structure

- Projects can be **nested**: a project can have **sub-projects** and a
  **parent project**.
- **Linked / dependency projects** can be associated so the AI can search and
  reference related work across projects.
- The **Project Overview** screen shows your projects as cards with their status
  and metrics.

### Creating projects

- **New Project** — clone from a Git URL or point to a project folder. Pasting a
  GitHub issue URL will resolve to the repository automatically.
- **Delete a project** from the project settings *Danger Zone*.

Each project has its own configuration (see

# Parse command-line arguments for workspace name and projects
while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
  case $1 in
    --name)
      WORKSPACE_NAME="$2"
      shift # past argument
      shift # past value
      ;;
    --projects)
      PROJECT_LIST="$2"
      shift # past argument
      shift # past value
      ;;
    *)
      echo "Unknown option $1"
      exit 1
      ;;
  esac
done

# Directory containing projects
PROJECT_DIR="/home/codx-junior-projects"

# Function to generate volume mappings for Docker run command
generate_volume_args() {
  VOL_ARGS=""
  IFS=',' read -r -a PROJECT_ARRAY <<< "${PROJECT_LIST}"
  for PROJECT in "${PROJECT_ARRAY[@]}"; do
    VOL_ARGS="${VOL_ARGS} -v ${PROJECT_DIR}/${PROJECT}:${PROJECT_DIR}/${PROJECT}"
  done
  echo "${VOL_ARGS}"
}

 * File: src/api/modules/infra.js
 * ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * BACKEND CONTRACT
 * ----------------
 * This module is written against a proposed REST contract under `/api/infra/*`.
 * Until the backend implements those routes, every method resolves against an
 * in-file mock dataset (see the `MOCK` object below).
 *
 * To switch to live HTTP with ZERO changes at the call sites, set
 * `USE_MOCK = false`. Every request is then issued through the regular
 * `API.get/post/delete` helpers (auth, base url, interceptors all apply).
 *
 * These routes MUST be gated to users with the `admin` role (container start/

/**
 * @typedef {Object} InfraHost
 * @property {string}  id          Stable host key, e.g. "host-local".
 * @property {string}  name        Human readable host name.
 * @property {string}  endpoint    Docker endpoint, e.g. "unix:///var/run/docker.sock".
 * @property {string}  engine      Docker engine version.
 * @property {string}  os          OS / arch string.
 * @property {number}  cpu_cores   Total CPU cores.
 * @property {number}  cpu_pct     Aggregate CPU usage percentage (0-100).
 * @property {number}  mem_total   Total memory in bytes.
 * @property {number}  mem_used    Used memory in bytes.
 * @property {number}  disk_total  Total disk in bytes.
 * @property {number}  disk_used   Used disk in bytes.
 * @property {boolean} is_local    Whether this is the local daemon.
 */

/**
 * @typedef {Object} InfraPort
 * @property {number|null} host       Published host port (null when not published).
 * @property {number}      container  Container-side port.
 * @property {string}     proto      "tcp" | "udp".
 * @property {boolean}    published  Whether the port is published to the host.
 */

/**
 * @typedef {Object} InfraMount
 * @property {string} type         "bind" | "volume" | "tmpfs".
 * @property {string} source       Host path or volume name.
 * @property {string} destination  Container path.
 * @property {string} mode         "rw" | "ro".
 */

/**
 * @typedef {Object} InfraNetworkAttachment
 * @property {string} name  Network name.
 * @property {string} ip    Assigned IP ("" when not connected).
 */

/**
 * @typedef {Object} InfraEnvVar

 */

/**

 * @property {number} retries   Retry count.

/**

/**
 * In-flight request deduplication map.
 * Key: "METHOD:url:serialized_body"
 * Value: Promise
 */
const _inflightRequests = new Map()

/**
 * Static, singleton socket manager shared across all API instances.
 */
let _staticSocketManager = null

/**
 * Build a stable cache key for a request.
 */
function _requestKey(method, url, data) {
  const body = data !== undefined ? JSON.stringify(data) : ''
  return `${method.toUpperCase()}:${url}:${body}`
}

/**
 * Wrap a request factory in deduplication logic.
 * If an identical request is already in-flight, the new caller
 * receives the same Promise (and therefore the same resolved value).
 */
function _dedupedRequest(method, url, data, requestFn) {
  const key = _requestKey(method, url, data)

  if (_inflightRequests.has(key)) {
    return _inflightRequests.get(key)
  }

  const promise = requestFn().finally(() => {
    _inflightRequests.delete(key)
  })

  _inflightRequests.set(key, promise)
  return promise
}

/**
 * ============================================================================
 * codx-junior — Infrastructure view state & actions
 * File: src/views/infra/useInfra.js
 * ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * A single, module-level reactive store shared by every infra component
 * (InfraView, ContainersPanel, ContainerDrawer). It wires directly into
 * `API.infra` (see src/api/modules/infra.js) which is currently mock-backed.
 * ============================================================================
 */
import { reactive, computed } from 'vue'
import { API } from '../../api/api'

/* ── formatting helpers (shared by tables + drawer) ─────────────────────── */

export function fmtBytes(b, d = 1) {
  if (b == null) return '—'
  const u = ['B', 'KB', 'MB', 'GB', 'TB']
  let i = 0
  let v = Number(b)
  while (v >= 1024 && i < u.length - 1) { v /= 1024; i++ }
  return v.toFixed(i === 0 ? 0 : d) + ' ' + u[i]
}

export function fmtDuration(sec) {
  if (sec == null) return '—'
  const d = Math.floor(sec / 86400)
  const h = Math.floor((sec % 86400) / 3600)
  const m = Math.floor((sec % 3600) / 60)
  if (d) return d + 'd ' + h + 'h'
  if (h) return h + 'h ' + m + 'm'
  if (m) return m + 'm'
  return Math.floor(sec) + 's'
}

export function timeAgo(iso) {
  const s = Math.max(0, Math.floor((Date.now() - new Date(iso).getTime()) / 1000))
  if (s < 60) return s + 's ago'
  if (s < 3600) return Math.floor(s / 60) + 'm ago'
  if (s < 86400) return Math.floor(s / 3600) + 'h ago'
  return Math.floor(s / 86400) + 'd ago'
}

export function fmtTime(iso) {
  const d = new Date(iso)
  const p = (n) => String(n).padStart(2, '0')
  return d.getFullYear() + '-' + p(d.getMonth() + 1) + '-' + p(d.getDate()) + ' ' +
    p(d.getHours()) + ':' + p(d.getMinutes()) + ':' + p(d.getSeconds())
}

/** Coarse traffic-light rating used for meters/progress. */
export function tone(v, hi, lo) {
  return v >= hi ? 'error' : v >= lo ? 'warning' : 'success'
}

/** Map a container to a DaisyUI badge descriptor. */
export function stateMeta(c) {
  if (c.state === 'running' && c.health === 'unhealthy') return { label: 'Unhealthy', key: 'error' }
  if (c.state === 'running' && c.health === 'starting') return { label: 'Starting', key: 'warning' }
  if (c.state === 'running' && c.health === 'healthy') return { label: 'Healthy', key: 'success' }
  if (c.state === 'running') return { label: 'Running', key: 'success' }
  if (c.state === 'restarting') return { label: 'Restarting', key: 'warning' }
  if (c.state === 'paused') return { label: 'Paused', key: 'info' }
  if (c.state === 'exited') return { label: 'Exited', key: 'neutral' }
  if (c.state === 'created') return { label: 'Created', key: 'info' }
  return { label: c.state, key: 'neutral' }
}

/* ── single shared reactive store ───────────────────────────────────────────
 * Module scope on purpose: the view is a singleton screen, and this keeps
 * ContainersPanel / ContainerDrawer in sync without prop drilling.
 * ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
const state = reactive({
  route: 'containers',
  hostId: 'host-local',
  hosts: [],
  status: 'idle',            // idle | loading | ready | error
  error: null,
  lastUpdated: null,
  autoRefresh: false,
  filters: { q: '', state: 'all', stack: 'all', sort: 'name' },
  containers: [],
  summary: null,
  stacks: [],
  images: [],
  volumes: [],
  networks: [],
  events: [],
  selected: [],              // bulk selection (container ids)
  selectedId: null,          // open drawer container id
  drawerTab: 'overview',
  drawer: { logs: null, stats: null, loadingLogs: false, loadingStats: false, tail: 120 },
  modal: null,               // { type: 'confirm'|'json'|'run', ... }
  toasts: [],
  _timer: null
})

/* ── toasts ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
function toast(text, kind = 'info') {
  const id = 't' + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2)
  state.toasts.push({ id, text, kind })
  setTimeout(() => {
    state.toasts = state.toasts.filter((t) => t.id !== id)
  }, 4200)
}

/* ── derived selectors ────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

const filteredList = computed(() => {
  const f = state.filters
  const term = f.q.trim().toLowerCase()
  let list
  if (state.route === 'containers') list = state.containers.slice()
  else if (state.route === 'stacks') list = state.stacks.slice()
  else if (state.route === 'images') list = state.images.slice()
  else if (state.route === 'volumes') list = state.volumes.slice()
  else if (state.route === 'networks') list = state.networks.slice()
  else list = state.events.slice()

  if (term) list = list.filter((x) => JSON.stringify(x).toLowerCase().includes(term))

  if (state.route === 'containers') {
    if (f.state !== 'all') list = list.filter((c) => (f.state === 'unhealthy' ? c.health === 'unhealthy' : c.state === f.state))
    if (f.stack !== 'all') list = list.filter((c) => c.stack === f.stack)
  }
  if (state.route === 'stacks' && f.stack !== 'all') list = list.filter((s) => s.name === f.stack)

  const cmp = (a, b) => String(a).localeCompare(String(b))
  if (f.sort === 'cpu') list.sort((a, b) => (b.cpu_pct || 0) - (a.cpu_pct || 0))
  else if (f.sort === 'mem') list.sort((a, b) => (b.mem_used || 0) - (a.mem_used || 0))
  else if (f.sort === 'created') list.sort((a, b) => String(b.created).localeCompare(String(a.created)))
  else list.sort((a, b) => cmp(a.name || a.repo || a.ts, b.name || b.repo || b.ts))

  return list
})

function tabCount(id) {
  switch (id) {
    case 'containers': return state.containers.length
    case 'stacks': return state.stacks.length
    case 'images': return state.images.length
    case 'volumes': return state.volumes.length
    case 'networks': return state.networks.length
    case 'events': return state.events.length
    default: return 0
  }
}

/* ── data loading ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

async function loadHosts() {
  try {
    const { hosts } = await API.infra.hosts()
    state.hosts = hosts
    if (!hosts.some((h) => h.id === state.hostId) && hosts.length) state.hostId = hosts[0].id
  } catch (e) {
    toast(e.message || 'Failed to load hosts', 'error')
  }
}

async function refreshSummary() {
  try {
    state.summary = await API.infra.summary(state.hostId)
  } catch { /* best effort */ }
}

async function loadAll() {
  state.status = 'loading'
  state.error = null
  try {
    const host = state.hostId
    const [summary, containers, stacks, images, volumes, networks, events] = await Promise.all([
      API.infra.summary(host),
      API.infra.containers({ host }),
      API.infra.stacks(host),
      API.infra.images(host),
      API.infra.volumes(host),
      API.infra.networks(host),
      API.infra.events(host)
    ])
    state.summary = summary
    state.containers = containers.containers
    state.stacks = stacks.stacks
    state.images = images.images
    state.volumes = volumes.volumes
    state.networks = networks.networks
    state.events = events.events
    state.status = 'ready'
    state.lastUpdated = new Date()
  } catch (e) {
    state.status = 'error'
    state.error = e.message || 'Unknown error'
  }
}

async function reloadCurrentTab() {
  const host = state.hostId
  try {
    if (state.route === 'containers') state.containers = (await API.infra.containers({ host })).containers
    else if (state.route === 'stacks') state.stacks = (await API.infra.stacks(host)).stacks
    else if (state.route === 'images') state.images = (await API.infra.images(host)).images
    else if (state.route === 'volumes') state.volumes = (await API.infra.volumes(host)).volumes
    else if (state.route === 'networks') state.networks = (await API.infra.networks(host)).networks
    else if (state.route === 'events') state.events = (await API.infra.events(host)).events
  } catch (e) {
    toast(e.message, 'error')
  }
}

/* ── navigation ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

function setRoute(route) {
  state.route = route
  state.selected = []
  state.filters.q = ''
  if (route !== 'containers') state.filters.q = ''
}

function setHost(hostId) {
  state.hostId = hostId
  state.selected = []
  state.closeDrawer()
  loadAll()
}

function setFilter(patch) {
  Object.assign(state.filters, patch)
}

/* ── selection ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

function toggleSelect(id, checked) {
  if (checked) { if (!state.selected.includes(id)) state.selected.push(id) }
  else state.selected = state.selected.filter((x) => x !== id)
}

function toggleSelectAll(checked) {
  state.selected = checked ? filteredList.value.map((x) => x.id) : []
}

function clearSelection() { state.selected = [] }

/* ── container actions ────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

async function containerAction(id, action) {
  const prev = state.containers.find((c) => c.id === id)
  try {
    const c = await API.infra.action(id, action)
    const i = state.containers.findIndex((x) => x.id === id)
    if (i >= 0) state.containers[i] = c
    toast((prev ? prev.name : id) + ' → ' + action, action === 'stop' || action === 'kill' ? 'warning' : 'success')
    await refreshSummary()
  } catch (e) {
    toast(e.message, 'error')
  }
}

async function bulkAction(action) {
  const ids = state.selected.slice()
  if (!ids.length) return
  for (const id of ids) {
    try {
      const c = await API.infra.action(id, action)
      const i = state.containers.findIndex((x) => x.id === id)
      if (i >= 0) state.containers[i] = c
    } catch { /* keep going */ }
  }
  toast('Bulk ' + action + ' done for ' + ids.length + ' container(s)', 'success')
  state.selected = []
  await refreshSummary()
}

function deleteContainer(id) {
  const c = state.containers.find((x) => x.id === id)
  state.modal = {
    type: 'confirm',
    title: 'Remove container',
    html: 'Remove <b>' + (c ? c.name : id) + '</b>? This stops the container and deletes it. Volumes are kept.',
    confirmText: 'Remove container',
    danger: true,
    onConfirm: async () => {
      state.modal = null
      try {
        await API.infra.remove(id)
        state.containers = state.containers.filter((x) => x.id !== id)
        if (state.selectedId === id) closeDrawer()
        toast('Container removed: ' + (c ? c.name : id), 'success')
        await refreshSummary()
      } catch (e) {
        toast(e.message, 'error')
      }
    }
  }
}

/* ── run container ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

function openRunModal() {
  state.modal = {
    type: 'run',
    form: { name: '', image: '', ports: '', env: '', cmd: '', stack: 'adhoc' },
    errors: {},
    submitting: false
  }
}

async function submitRun() {
  const m = state.modal
  if (!m || m.type !== 'run') return
  const f = m.form
  const errors = {}
  if (!f.name.trim()) errors.name = 'Container name is required'
  else if (!/^[a-zA-Z0-9][a-zA-Z0-9_.-]*$/.test(f.name.trim())) errors.name = 'Use letters, digits, _ . - only'
  if (!f.image.trim()) errors.image = 'Image reference is required (e.g. redis:7-alpine)'
  m.errors = errors
  if (Object.keys(errors).length) return

  m.submitting = true
  try {
    const ports = f.ports.split(',').map((s) => s.trim()).filter(Boolean).map((p) => {
      const [h, c] = p.split(':')
      return { host: Number(h), container: Number(c || h), proto: 'tcp' }
    })
    const env = f.env.split(/[\n,]/).map((s) => s.trim()).filter(Boolean).map((kv) => {
      const i = kv.indexOf('=')
      return { k: i < 0 ? kv : kv.slice(0, i), v: i < 0 ? '' : kv.slice(i + 1) }
    })
    const c = await API.infra.create({
      name: f.name.trim(), image: f.image.trim(), ports, env, cmd: f.cmd, stack: f.stack
    })
    state.modal = null
    toast('Started container "' + c.name + '"', 'success')
    await loadAll()
    openDrawer(c.id, 'overview')
  } catch (e) {
    m.submitting = false
    toast(e.message, 'error')
  }
}

function updateRunField(field, value) {
  if (!state.modal || state.modal.type !== 'run') return
  state.modal.form[field] = value
  if (state.modal.errors) delete state.modal.errors[field]
}

/* ── drawer ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

function openDrawer(id, tab) {
  state.selectedId = id
  state.drawerTab = tab || state.drawerTab || 'overview'
  state.drawer.logs = null
  state.drawer.stats = null
  if (state.drawerTab === 'logs') loadLogs(id)
  if (state.drawerTab === 'stats') loadStats(id)
}

function closeDrawer() {
  state.selectedId = null
}

function setDrawerTab(tab) {
  state.drawerTab = tab
  if (tab === 'logs' && !state.drawer.logs) loadLogs(state.selectedId)
  if (tab === 'stats' && !state.drawer.stats) loadStats(state.selectedId)
}

async function loadLogs(id) {
  state.drawer.loadingLogs = true
  state.drawer.logs = null
  try {
    const r = await API.infra.logs(id, state.drawer.tail)
    if (state.selectedId !== id) return
    state.drawer.logs = r.lines
  } catch (e) {
    toast(e.message, 'error')
  } finally {
    state.drawer.loadingLogs = false
  }
}

async function loadStats(id) {
  state.drawer.loadingStats = true
  state.drawer.stats = null
  try {
    const r = await API.infra.stats(id)
    if (state.selectedId !== id) return
    state.drawer.stats = r
  } catch (e) {
    toast(e.message, 'error')
  } finally {
    state.drawer.loadingStats = false
  }
}

function setLogTail(n) {
  state.drawer.tail = n
  if (state.selectedId) loadLogs(state.selectedId)
}

/* ── live polling (mock daemon "feels" live) ──────────────────────────────── */

function startLive() {
  stopLive()
  state._timer = setInterval(async () => {
    await reloadCurrentTab()
    await refreshSummary()
    state.lastUpdated = new Date()
  }, 3000)
}

function stopLive() {
  if (state._timer) { clearInterval(state._timer); state._timer = null }
}

function toggleLive(on) {
  state.autoRefresh = on
  if (on) { startLive(); toast('Live updates on (polling every 3s)', 'info') }
  else { stopLive(); toast('Live updates paused', 'info') }
}

/* ── clipboard ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

function copyText(text) {
  const done = () => toast('Copied to clipboard', 'success')
  if (navigator.clipboard && navigator.clipboard.writeText) {
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(text).then(done).catch(() => toast('Copy blocked by browser', 'warning'))
  } else {
    const ta = document.createElement('textarea')
    ta.value = text
    document.body.appendChild(ta)
    ta.select()
    try { document.execCommand('copy'); done() } catch { toast('Copy not supported', 'warning') }
    ta.remove()
  }
}

/* ── public API ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

export function useInfra() {
  return {
    state,
    filteredList,
    tabCount,

    // data
    loadHosts, loadAll, refreshSummary, reloadCurrentTab,

    // navigation / filters
    setRoute, setHost, setFilter,

    // selection
    toggleSelect, toggleSelectAll, clearSelection,

    // actions
    containerAction, bulkAction, deleteContainer,
    openRunModal, submitRun, updateRunField,

    // drawer
    openDrawer, closeDrawer, setDrawerTab, loadLogs, loadStats, setLogTail,

    // misc
    toast, startLive, stopLive, toggleLive, copyText
  }
}

  useInfra, TABS, fmtTime, fmtBytes, tone
} from './useInfra'
import ContainersPanel from './ContainersPanel.vue'
import ContainerDrawer from './ContainerDrawer.vue'
import StacksPanel from './StacksPanel.vue'

import VolumesPanel from './VolumesPanel.vue'

const {
  state, filteredList, tabCount,
  loadHosts, loadAll, setRoute, setHost, setFilter,
  openRunModal, submitRun, updateRunField,
  toggleLive
} = useInfra()

/* ── derived ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
const counts = computed(() => state.summary?.counts || {
  total: 0, running: 0, stopped: 0, paused: 0, restarting: 0, unhealthy: 0, images: 0, volumes: 0, networks: 0
})

const memPct = computed(() => {
  const s = state.summary

<script setup>
import { computed } from 'vue'
import { useInfra, fmtBytes, fmtTime, stateMeta } from './useInfra'

const {
  state, closeDrawer, setDrawerTab, loadLogs, loadStats, setLogTail,
  containerAction, deleteContainer, copyText
} = useInfra()

const drawerTabs = [
  { id: 'overview', label: 'Overview', icon: 'fa-circle-info' },
  { id: 'stats', label: 'Stats', icon: 'fa-chart-simple' },
  { id: 'logs', label: 'Logs', icon: 'fa-terminal' },
  { id: 'inspect', label: 'Inspect', icon: 'fa-code' },
  { id: 'volumes', label: 'Volumes', icon: 'fa-database' },
  { id: 'networks', label: 'Networks', icon: 'fa-network-wired' },
  { id: 'env', label: 'Env', icon: 'fa-list' }
]

const container = computed(() =>
  state.selectedId ? state.containers.find((c) => c.id === state.selectedId) : null
)

const stats = computed(() => state.drawer.stats || { current: {}, series: [] })
const statsMemPct = computed(() => {
  const c = stats.value.current
  return c.mem_limit ? Math.round((c.mem_used / c.mem_limit) * 100) : 0
})

const labelEntries = computed(() =>
  container.value && container.value.labels ? Object.entries(container.value.labels) : []
)

const overviewRows = computed(() => {
  const c = container.value
  if (!c) return []
  const meta = stateMeta(c)
  const net = (c.networks || [])
  const ports = (c.ports || []).length
    ? c.ports.map((p) => '<span class="font-mono">' + (p.published ? p.host + '→' : '') + p.container + '/' + p.proto + '</span>').join(' · ')
    : '—'
  return [
    { k: 'State', v: '<span class="badge badge-xs badge-' + meta.key + '">' + meta.label + '</span> <span class="opacity-60">' + (c.status_text || '') + '</span>' },
    { k: 'Host', v: c.host_id },
    { k: 'Stack / Service', v: (c.stack || '—') + (c.service ? ' / ' + c.service : '') },
    { k: 'Image', v: '<span class="font-mono">' + c.image + '</span>' },
    { k: 'Container ID', v: '<span class="font-mono">' + c.short + '</span>' },
    { k: 'Created', v: fmtTime(c.created) },
    { k: 'Started', v: (c.state === 'running' || c.state === 'paused') ? fmtTime(c.started_at) : '—' },
    { k: 'Restart policy', v: (c.restart_policy || '—') + ' · restarts: ' + (c.restart_count || 0) },
    { k: 'Ports', v: ports },
    { k: 'URL', v: c.url ? '<a class="link link-primary" href="' + c.url + '" target="_blank">' + c.url + '</a>' : '—' },
    { k: 'CPU / PIDs', v: (c.cpu_pct || 0).toFixed(1) + '% · ' + (c.pids || 0) + ' pids' },
    { k: 'Memory', v: fmtBytes(c.mem_used) + ' / ' + fmtBytes(c.mem_limit) },
    { k: 'Entrypoint', v: c.entrypoint ? '<span class="font-mono text-[11px]">' + c.entrypoint + '</span>' : '—' },
    { k: 'Command', v: (c.cmd && c.cmd.length) ? '<span class="font-mono text-[11px]">' + c.cmd.join(' ') + '</span>' : '—' },
    { k: 'Connected networks', v: net.length ? net.map((n) => '<span class="font-mono">' + n.name + '</span>').join(', ') : '—' }
  ]
})

const statsRows = computed(() => {
  const cur = stats.value.current
  return [
    { k: 'Network I/O', v: 'RX ' + fmtBytes(cur.net_rx) + ' · TX ' + fmtBytes(cur.net_tx) },
    { k: 'Block I/O', v: 'Read ' + fmtBytes(cur.block_read) + ' · Write ' + fmtBytes(cur.block_write) },
    { k: 'PIDs', v: String(cur.pids || 0) },
    { k: 'Sample', v: '1s interval · aggregated over 60s window (mock)' }
  ]
})

const inspectJson = computed(() => {
  const c = container.value
  if (!c) return ''
  return JSON.stringify({
    Id: c.id,
    Name: '/' + c.name,
    Created: c.created,
    Image: c.image,
    State: { Status: c.state, Health: c.health ? { Status: c.health } : undefined, RestartCount: c.restart_count || 0, StartedAt: c.started_at },
    HostConfig: { RestartPolicy: { Name: c.restart_policy }, PortBindings: c.ports },
    Config: { Image: c.image, Env: (c.env || []).map((e) => e.k + '=' + e.v), Cmd: c.cmd, Labels: c.labels, Healthcheck: c.healthcheck },
    Mounts: c.mounts,
    NetworkSettings: { Networks: (c.networks || []).reduce((a, n) => (a[n.name] = { IPAddress: n.ip }, a), {}) }
  }, null, 2)
})

function barClass (v, hi, lo) {
  if (v >= hi) return 'bg-error'
  if (v >= lo) return 'bg-warning'
  return 'bg-success'
}
function levelClass (level) {
  return {
    INFO: 'text-info',
    WARN: 'text-warning',
    ERROR: 'text-error',
    DEBUG: 'opacity-50'
  }[level] || ''
}
</script>

Everything below is defined in **`src/api/modules/infra.js`** (the `INFRA_ENDPOINTS` array + JSDoc typedefs). All routes **must be admin-gated**. Flip `USE_MOCK = false` once they're live — no UI changes needed.

| GET | `/api/infra/containers` | `host,state,stack,q` | `{ total, containers: InfraContainer[] }` |

/**
 * ============================================================================
 * codx-junior — Infrastructure (Docker) API module
 * File: src/api/modules/infra.js
 * ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * BACKEND CONTRACT
 * ----------------
 * This module is written against a proposed REST contract under `/api/infra/*`.
 * Until the backend implements those routes, every method resolves against an
 * in-file mock dataset (see the `MOCK` object below).
 *
 * To switch to live HTTP with ZERO changes at the call sites, set
 * `USE_MOCK = false`. Every request is then issued through the regular
 * `API.get/post/delete` helpers (auth, base url, interceptors all apply).
 *
 * These routes MUST be gated to users with the `admin` role (container start/
 * stop/exec is a privileged operation).
 *
 * The machine-readable contract is exported as `INFRA_ENDPOINTS` and mirrored
 * by the JSDoc typedefs further down.
 * ============================================================================
 */

/* ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 * 1. CONTRACT — hand this to the backend team
 * ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

/**
 * @typedef {Object} InfraHost
 * @property {string}  id          Stable host key, e.g. "host-local".
 * @property {string}  name        Human readable host name.
 * @property {string}  endpoint    Docker endpoint, e.g. "unix:///var/run/docker.sock".
 * @property {string}  engine      Docker engine version.
 * @property {string}  os          OS / arch string.
 * @property {number}  cpu_cores   Total CPU cores.
 * @property {number}  cpu_pct     Aggregate CPU usage percentage (0-100).
 * @property {number}  mem_total   Total memory in bytes.
 * @property {number}  mem_used    Used memory in bytes.
 * @property {number}  disk_total  Total disk in bytes.
 * @property {number}  disk_used   Used disk in bytes.
 * @property {boolean} is_local    Whether this is the local daemon.
 */

/**
 * @typedef {Object} InfraPort
 * @property {number|null} host       Published host port (null when not published).
 * @property {number}      container  Container-side port.
 * @property {string}     proto      "tcp" | "udp".
 * @property {boolean}    published  Whether the port is published to the host.
 */

/**
 * @typedef {Object} InfraMount
 * @property {string} type         "bind" | "volume" | "tmpfs".
 * @property {string} source       Host path or volume name.
 * @property {string} destination  Container path.
 * @property {string} mode         "rw" | "ro".
 */

/**
 * @typedef {Object} InfraNetworkAttachment
 * @property {string} name  Network name.
 * @property {string} ip    Assigned IP ("" when not connected).
 */

/**
 * @typedef {Object} InfraEnvVar
 * @property {string} k  Variable name.
 * @property {string} v  Variable value (backend SHOULD mask secrets).
 */

/**
 * @typedef {Object} InfraHealthcheck
 * @property {string} test      Healthcheck command.
 * @property {string} interval  e.g. "30s".
 * @property {number} retries   Retry count.
 */

/**
 * @typedef {Object} InfraContainer
 * @property {string}  id               Full container id.
 * @property {string}  short            Short id (first 12 chars).
 * @property {string}  name             Container name.
 * @property {string}  image            Image reference "repo:tag".
 * @property {string}  image_id         Image SHA.
 * @property {'running'|'exited'|'paused'|'restarting'|'created'|'dead'} state  Lifecycle state.
 * @property {'healthy'|'unhealthy'|'starting'|null} health                     Health status (null if no healthcheck).
 * @property {string}  status_text      docker ps STATUS text, e.g. "Up 3 days".
 * @property {string}  created          ISO 8601.
 * @property {string}  started_at       ISO 8601.
 * @property {number}  uptime_seconds   Seconds since last start.
 * @property {string}  host_id          Owning host (see InfraHost.id).
 * @property {string}  stack            Compose project name ("" when none).
 * @property {string}  service          Compose service name ("" when none).
 * @property {InfraPort[]} ports
 * @property {number}  cpu_pct          Current CPU %.
 * @property {number}  mem_used         Current memory in bytes.
 * @property {number}  mem_limit        Memory limit in bytes.
 * @property {number}  mem_pct          Derived memory percentage.
 * @property {number}  net_rx           Total network received bytes.
 * @property {number}  net_tx           Total network transmitted bytes.
 * @property {number}  block_read       Total block read bytes.
 * @property {number}  block_write      Total block written bytes.
 * @property {number}  restart_count    Number of restarts.
 * @property {string}  restart_policy   e.g. "unless-stopped".
 * @property {Object.<string,string>} labels  docker labels.
 * @property {InfraEnvVar[]} env
 * @property {InfraMount[]}  mounts
 * @property {InfraNetworkAttachment[]} networks
 * @property {string[]} cmd
 * @property {string}  entrypoint
 * @property {InfraHealthcheck|null} healthcheck
 * @property {string|null} url          Exposed app URL (when discoverable).
 * @property {boolean} sysbox           Whether run under the sysbox runtime.
 * @property {number}  pids             Process count.
 */

/**
 * @typedef {Object} InfraStats
 * @property {{cpu_pct:number, mem_used:number, mem_limit:number, net_rx:number, net_tx:number, block_read:number, block_write:number, pids:number}} current
 * @property {{t:string, cpu:number, mem:number}[]} series  Time series (ISO ts + values).
 */

/**
 * Machine-readable endpoint contract. Ship this array to the backend team.
 * @type {{method:string, path:string, desc:string, response:string}[]}
 */

  { method: 'GET',    path: '/api/infra/hosts',              desc: 'List Docker hosts/endpoints.',                     response: '{ hosts: InfraHost[] }' },

  { method: 'GET',    path: '/api/infra/volumes',            desc: 'Volumes on the host.',                             query: 'host', response: '{ volumes: { name, driver, scope, mountpoint, size, stack, in_use, anonymous }[] }' },
  { method: 'GET',    path: '/api/infra/networks',           desc: 'Networks on the host.',                            query: 'host', response: '{ networks: { id, name, driver, scope, subnet, internal, containers[] }[] }' },
  { method: 'GET',    path: '/api/infra/events',             desc: 'Recent Docker daemon events.',                     query: 'host', response: '{ events: { ts, type, action, actor }[] }' }

function _fmtDur(sec) {
  if (sec == null) return '—'
  const d = Math.floor(sec / 86400), h = Math.floor((sec % 86400) / 3600), m = Math.floor((sec % 3600) / 60)
  if (d) return d + 'd ' + h + 'h'
  if (h) return h + 'h ' + m + 'm'
  if (m) return m + 'm'
  return Math.floor(sec) + 's'
}

function _applyDerived() {
  MOCK.containers.forEach((c) => {
    c.short = c.id.slice(0, 12)
    c.mem_pct = c.mem_limit ? Math.min(100, Math.round((c.mem_used / c.mem_limit) * 100)) : 0
    if (c.state === 'running' && c.started_at) {
      c.uptime_seconds = Math.max(0, Math.floor((Date.now() - new Date(c.started_at).getTime()) / 1000))
    }
    if (c.state === 'running') c.status_text = 'Up ' + _fmtDur(c.uptime_seconds)
    else if (c.state === 'restarting') c.status_text = 'Restarting (' + (c.restart_count || 1) + ')'
    else if (c.state === 'paused') c.status_text = 'Up ' + _fmtDur(c.uptime_seconds) + ' (Paused)'
    else if (c.state === 'exited') c.status_text = c.status_text || 'Exited (0)'
    else if (c.state === 'created') c.status_text = 'Created'
  })
}
_applyDerived()

function _findContainer(idOrName) {
  return MOCK.containers.find((c) => c.id === idOrName || c.name === idOrName)
}

function _hostContainers(hostId) {
  return MOCK.containers.filter((c) => c.host_id === hostId)
}

function _buildSummary(hostId) {
  const host = MOCK.hosts.find((h) => h.id === hostId) || MOCK.hosts[0]
  const list = _hostContainers(hostId)
  const running = list.filter((c) => c.state === 'running')
  return {
    host,
    engine: host.engine,
    cpu_pct: host.cpu_pct,
    cpu_cores: host.cpu_cores,
    mem_used: host.mem_used,
    mem_total: host.mem_total,
    disk_used: host.disk_used,
    disk_total: host.disk_total,
    counts: {
      total: list.length,
      running: running.length,
      stopped: list.filter((c) => c.state === 'exited' || c.state === 'created').length,
      paused: list.filter((c) => c.state === 'paused').length,
      restarting: list.filter((c) => c.state === 'restarting').length,
      unhealthy: list.filter((c) => c.health === 'unhealthy').length,
      images: _activeImages(hostId).filter((i) => !i.dangling).length,
      volumes: _activeVolumes(hostId).length,
      networks: _activeNetworks(hostId).length
    }
  }
}

function _activeImages(hostId) {
  return MOCK.images.filter((i) => {
    const used = MOCK.containers.some((c) => c.host_id === hostId && c.image === i.repo + ':' + i.tag)
    return used || i.dangling
  }).map((i) => Object.assign({}, i, {
    containers: MOCK.containers.filter((c) => c.host_id === hostId && c.image === i.repo + ':' + i.tag).length
  }))
}

function _activeVolumes(hostId) {
  return MOCK.volumes
    .filter((v) => (v.host_id || 'host-local') === hostId)
    .map((v) => Object.assign({}, v, {
      in_use: MOCK.containers.some((c) => c.host_id === hostId && c.mounts.some((m) => m.source === v.name))
    }))
}

function _activeNetworks(hostId) {
  return MOCK.networks
    .filter((n) => (n.host_id || 'host-local') === hostId)
    .map((n) => Object.assign({}, n, {
      containers: MOCK.containers
        .filter((c) => c.host_id === hostId && c.networks.some((cn) => cn.name === n.name))
        .map((c) => c.name)
    }))
}

function _buildStacks(hostId) {
  const map = {}
  _hostContainers(hostId).forEach((c) => {
    if (!c.stack) return
    map[c.stack] = map[c.stack] || { name: c.stack, host_id: hostId, services: [] }
    map[c.stack].services.push({ service: c.service, name: c.name, state: c.state, health: c.health, id: c.id })
  })
  return Object.values(map).map((s) => {
    const running = s.services.filter((x) => x.state === 'running').length
    s.status = running === s.services.length ? 'running' : running === 0 ? 'stopped' : 'degraded'
    s.running = running
    s.total = s.services.length
    s.path = '/opt/codx-junior/' + s.name + '/docker-compose.yaml'
    return s
  }).sort((a, b) => a.name.localeCompare(b.name))
}

function _genLogs(c, tail) {
  if (!c) return []

  const svc = c.service || c.name
  const pool = {

  const key = Object.keys(pool).find((k) => svc.includes(k) || (c.image || '').includes(k))
  const base = pool[key] || [['INFO', svc + ' started'],
    ['WARN', 'deprecation notice: legacy config key detected'],
    ['ERROR', 'connection refused to upstream, will retry in 5s'],
    ['INFO', 'healthy']]
  const out = []
  for (let i = n - 1; i >= 0; i--) {

    out.push({ ts: _isoAgo(i * 1300 + Math.floor(_rnd() * 900)), level: tpl[0], msg: tpl[1] })

function _genStats(c) {
  if (!c) return { current: {}, series: [] }
  const series = []
  let cpu = c.cpu_pct || 1
  let mem = c.mem_used || 0
  for (let i = 39; i >= 0; i--) {
    cpu = Math.max(0, cpu + (_rnd() - 0.5) * Math.max(0.4, (c.cpu_pct || 1) * 0.25))
    mem = Math.max(0, mem + (_rnd() - 0.5) * (c.mem_limit || GiB) * 0.02)
    series.push({ t: _isoAgo(MIN * i * 1.5), cpu: +cpu.toFixed(1), mem: Math.round(Math.min(mem, c.mem_limit || GiB)) })
  }
  return {
    current: {
      cpu_pct: c.cpu_pct || 0, mem_used: c.mem_used || 0, mem_limit: c.mem_limit || 0,
      net_rx: c.net_rx || 0, net_tx: c.net_tx || 0,
      block_read: c.block_read || 0, block_write: c.block_write || 0, pids: c.pids || 0
    },
    series
  }
}

function _doAction(id, action) {
  const c = _findContainer(id)
  if (!c) return null
  if (action === 'start' || action === 'restart') {
    c.state = 'running'
    if (c.health !== 'unhealthy') c.health = c.healthcheck ? 'starting' : c.health
    c.started_at = new Date().toISOString()
    c.uptime_seconds = 0
    if (action === 'restart') c.restart_count = (c.restart_count || 0) + 1
  } else if (action === 'stop' || action === 'kill') {
    c.state = 'exited'; c.health = null; c.cpu_pct = 0; c.mem_used = 0
  } else if (action === 'pause') {
    c.state = 'paused'; c.cpu_pct = 0
  } else if (action === 'unpause') {
    c.state = 'running'
  }
  c.status_text = ''
  _applyDerived()
  MOCK.events.unshift({ ts: new Date().toISOString(), type: 'container', action, actor: c.name })
  return Object.assign({}, c)
}

    created: new Date().toISOString(), started_at: new Date().toISOString(), uptime_seconds: 0,
    host_id: body.host_id || 'host-local', stack: body.stack || 'adhoc', service: body.name,
    ports: (body.ports || []).filter(Boolean).map((p) => ({ host: p.host, container: p.container, proto: p.proto || 'tcp', published: true })),
    cpu_pct: 0.6, mem_used: 32 * MiB, mem_limit: 512 * MiB,
    env: (body.env || []).filter(Boolean),
    cmd: (body.cmd || '').trim() ? body.cmd.trim().split(/\s+/) : []
  })
  MOCK.containers.push(c)
  _applyDerived()
  MOCK.events.unshift({ ts: new Date().toISOString(), type: 'container', action: 'create', actor: c.name })
  return Object.assign({}, c)
}

function _removeContainer(id) {
  const i = MOCK.containers.findIndex((x) => x.id === id || x.name === id)
  if (i < 0) return null
  const name = MOCK.containers[i].name
  MOCK.containers.splice(i, 1)
  MOCK.events.unshift({ ts: new Date().toISOString(), type: 'container', action: 'destroy', actor: name })
  return { ok: true }
}

function _listContainers(search) {
  const host = search.get('host') || 'host-local'
  let list = _hostContainers(host)
  const st = search.get('state')
  const stack = search.get('stack')
  const term = (search.get('q') || '').toLowerCase()
  if (st && st !== 'all') list = list.filter((c) => (st === 'unhealthy' ? c.health === 'unhealthy' : c.state === st))
  if (stack && stack !== 'all') list = list.filter((c) => c.stack === stack)
  if (term) {
    list = list.filter((c) =>
      c.name.toLowerCase().includes(term) ||
      c.image.toLowerCase().includes(term) ||
      c.service.toLowerCase().includes(term) ||
      c.stack.toLowerCase().includes(term))
  }
  return { total: list.length, containers: list.map((c) => Object.assign({}, c)) }
}

// MOCK: tiny router reproducing the REST contract above
function _route(method, pathname, search, body) {
  let m
  if (method === 'GET' && pathname === '/api/infra/hosts') return { hosts: MOCK.hosts }
  if (method === 'GET' && pathname === '/api/infra/summary') return _buildSummary(search.get('host') || 'host-local')
  if (method === 'GET' && pathname === '/api/infra/containers') return _listContainers(search)

  if (method === 'GET' && (m = pathname.match(/^\/api\/infra\/containers\/([^/]+)\/logs$/))) {
    return { id: m[1], lines: _genLogs(_findContainer(m[1]), Number(search.get('tail') || 120)) }
  }
  if (method === 'GET' && (m = pathname.match(/^\/api\/infra\/containers\/([^/]+)\/stats$/))) {
    return _genStats(_findContainer(m[1]))
  }
  if (method === 'POST' && (m = pathname.match(/^\/api\/infra\/containers\/([^/]+)\/actions$/))) {
    return _doAction(m[1], body && body.action)
  }
  if (method === 'GET' && (m = pathname.match(/^\/api\/infra\/containers\/([^/]+)$/))) {
    const c = _findContainer(m[1]); return c ? Object.assign({}, c) : null
  }
  if (method === 'DELETE' && (m = pathname.match(/^\/api\/infra\/containers\/([^/]+)$/))) {
    return _removeContainer(m[1])
  }
  if (method === 'POST' && pathname === '/api/infra/containers') return _createContainer(body || {})

  if (method === 'GET' && pathname === '/api/infra/stacks') return { stacks: _buildStacks(search.get('host') || 'host-local') }
  if (method === 'GET' && pathname === '/api/infra/images') return { images: _activeImages(search.get('host') || 'host-local') }
  if (method === 'GET' && pathname === '/api/infra/volumes') return { volumes: _activeVolumes(search.get('host') || 'host-local') }
  if (method === 'GET' && pathname === '/api/infra/networks') return { networks: _activeNetworks(search.get('host') || 'host-local') }
  if (method === 'GET' && pathname === '/api/infra/events') return { events: MOCK.events.slice(0, 60) }
  return null
}

function _mock(method, path, body) {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    // MOCK: simulated latency so loading states are visible
    setTimeout(() => {
      try {
        const parsed = new URL(path, 'http://mock.local')
        const result = _route(method, parsed.pathname, parsed.searchParams, body)
        if (result == null) reject(new Error('infra mock: no route for ' + method + ' ' + path))
        else resolve(result)
      } catch (err) {
        reject(err)
      }
    }, 120 + Math.random() * 260)
  })
}

/* ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 * 3. MODULE — the public API surface used by the UI
 * ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

/**
 * Infrastructure module factory.
 * @param {object} API  The codx-junior API instance (see src/api/api.js).
 */
export function infraModule(API) {
  const get = (path) => (USE_MOCK ? _mock('GET', path) : API.get(path))
  const post = (path, body) => (USE_MOCK ? _mock('POST', path, body) : API.post(path, body))
  const del = (path) => (USE_MOCK ? _mock('DELETE', path) : API.delete(path))

  const slug = (id) => encodeURIComponent(id)
  const hostQs = (host) => 'host=' + encodeURIComponent(host || 'host-local')

  return {
    /** @type {boolean} true while the UI runs against in-file mock data. */
    isMock: USE_MOCK,
    /** @type {typeof INFRA_ENDPOINTS} machine-readable backend contract. */
    endpoints: INFRA_ENDPOINTS,

    /** @returns {Promise<{hosts: import('./infra').InfraHost[]}>} */
    hosts: () => get('/api/infra/hosts'),

    /** @returns {Promise<object>} host gauges + counts */
    summary: (host = 'host-local') => get('/api/infra/summary?' + hostQs(host)),

    /**
     * @param {{host?:string,state?:string,stack?:string,q?:string}} params
     * @returns {Promise<{total:number, containers:any[]}>}
     */
    containers: (params = {}) => {
      const q = new URLSearchParams()
      if (params.host) q.set('host', params.host)
      if (params.state) q.set('state', params.state)
      if (params.stack) q.set('stack', params.stack)
      if (params.q) q.set('q', params.q)
      const qs = q.toString()
      return get('/api/infra/containers' + (qs ? '?' + qs : ''))
    },

    container: (id) => get('/api/infra/containers/' + slug(id)),
    logs: (id, tail = 120) => get('/api/infra/containers/' + slug(id) + '/logs?tail=' + tail),
    stats: (id) => get('/api/infra/containers/' + slug(id) + '/stats'),

    /** @param {'start'|'stop'|'restart'|'pause'|'unpause'|'kill'} action */
    action: (id, action) => post('/api/infra/containers/' + slug(id) + '/actions', { action }),

    /** @param {{name:string,image:string,ports?:any[],env?:any[],cmd?:string,stack?:string}} payload */
    create: (payload) => post('/api/infra/containers', payload),
    remove: (id) => del('/api/infra/containers/' + slug(id)),

    stacks: (host = 'host-local') => get('/api/infra/stacks?' + hostQs(host)),
    images: (host = 'host-local') => get('/api/infra/images?' + hostQs(host)),
    volumes: (host = 'host-local') => get('/api/infra/volumes?' + hostQs(host)),
    networks: (host = 'host-local') => get('/api/infra/networks?' + hostQs(host)),
    events: (host = 'host-local') => get('/api/infra/events?' + hostQs(host))
  }
}

Here is the diagnosis and the fix. --- ## 1. Analysis & Pre-Thinking **Core requirements** - Make the four data tabs (**Containers, Images, Volumes, Networks**) actually display their rows. - Change the "stopped" counter badge in the KPI strip to an **outline** badge. **Root cause** The two panels that *do* render (`StacksPanel`, `EventsPanel`) contain **no breakpoint visibility classes at all** — they render their list unconditionally. The four broken panels are the only ones that ship **two duplicated markups** behind a CSS visibility switch: ```html
``` Two concrete problems with this: 1. `hidden` / `lg:block` sit on the **same element as `.card`**, and daisyUI ships `.card { display: flex }`. Depending on cascade order (components vs. utilities layer) `display` fights itself, which is exactly the failure mode where a card renders nothing. 2. `lg:` is a **viewport** media query. Inside a dockview panel the usable width is much smaller than the window, so the table branch gets hidden while the card branch is the only survivor — and vice versa. Either way the list is gated behind a breakpoint instead of being gated by data. The reliable fix is therefore not a breakpoint tweak, but **removing the duplicated markup**: one table per panel, always rendered, horizontally scrollable when the panel is narrow. That also matches the two panels that already work. **Dependencies & risks** - No API, state-store or `useInfra` changes — only presentation. - Row actions, empty states and mobile usability are preserved (table scrolls horizontally). - `GET /api/infra/*` payloads untouched. **Target files** - `src/views/infra/ContainersPanel.vue` - `src/views/infra/ImagesPanel.vue` - `src/views/infra/VolumesPanel.vue` - `src/views/infra/NetworksPanel.vue` - `src/views/infra/InfraView.vue` --- ## 2. /**
 * ============================================================================
 * Infrastructure — panel layout detection.
 * ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * InfraView is rendered inside a RESIZABLE dockview panel, so "mobile" has to
 * mean "THIS PANEL is narrow" — not "the browser window is narrow".
 *
 * Container-query utilities (`@2xl:`, `@3xl:`…) did not resolve inside the
 * dockview panel in this build, which left the tables permanently `hidden`
 * and only the card markup visible. The width is therefore measured directly
 * with a ResizeObserver and exposed as reactive flags.
 *
 * The panels then MOUNT one markup or the other (`v-if`) instead of rendering
 * both and hiding one with CSS:
 *   • deterministic — no dependency on container-query support;
 *   • no `display` conflict with daisyUI's `.card` (which sets its own
 *     `display`, the reason `class="hidden md:block card"` never worked).
 * ============================================================================
 */
import { reactive } from 'vue'

/** Widths (px) at which the layout switches. Mirrors the Tailwind container scale. */
export const LAYOUT_BREAKPOINTS = {
  xl: 576, // events: single-line rows
  '2xl': 672, // header / KPI strip / filters stack; simple lists become cards
  '3xl': 768, // containers: cards instead of the 6-column table
  '4xl': 896 // stacks: two columns
}

/**
 * Reactive layout flags read by the infra components.
 *
 *  inline  – panel is wide enough for one-line event rows
 *  compact – panel is narrow: stack header / KPIs / filters, lists become cards
 *  cards   – panel is narrow: container list uses cards (needs more room than
 *            the simple lists because its table has 6 dense columns)
 *  twoCol  – panel is wide enough for two stack cards side by side
 *  width   – last measured width (debug aid; nothing renders from it)
 */
export const layout = reactive({
  width: 0,
  inline: false,
  compact: true,
  cards: true,
  twoCol: false
})

let observer = null

/** Recomputes the flags. Same-value assignments do not trigger re-renders. */
function apply(width) {
  const w = Math.max(0, Math.round(width || 0))
  layout.width = w
  layout.inline = w >= LAYOUT_BREAKPOINTS.xl
  layout.compact = w < LAYOUT_BREAKPOINTS['2xl']
  layout.cards = w < LAYOUT_BREAKPOINTS['3xl']
  layout.twoCol = w >= LAYOUT_BREAKPOINTS['4xl']
}

/** Stops observing (safe to call repeatedly). */
export function disposePanelWidth() {
  if (observer) {
    observer.disconnect()
    observer = null
  }
}

/**
 * Starts tracking the width of `el`.
 * Returns a disposer — call it from `onBeforeUnmount`.
 */
export function observePanelWidth(el) {
  disposePanelWidth()
  if (!el) return disposePanelWidth

  apply(el.clientWidth)

  // Fallback for environments without ResizeObserver.
  if (typeof ResizeObserver === 'undefined') {
    const onResize = () => apply(el.clientWidth)
    window.addEventListener('resize', onResize)
    observer = { disconnect: () => window.removeEventListener('resize', onResize) }
    return disposePanelWidth
  }

  observer = new ResizeObserver(() => apply(el.clientWidth))
  observer.observe(el)
  return disposePanelWidth
}

Here is my analysis before the code.

## 1. Analysis & Pre-Thinking

**Core requirements**
1. `Inspect` on a container must behave like `Logs`: it opens the container detail overlay on a dedicated tab, instead of popping a JSON dialog that detaches you from the container context.
2. A new **Maintenance** section in `InfraView`: detect old/stale resources (stopped containers, unused/dangling images, unused volumes, unused networks), delete them individually or in bulk, and run prune operations.

**Strategic approach**
1. **Inspect → tab.** Add an `inspect` route to the drawer tab strip. `openContainer(id, 'inspect')` already re-asserts the requested tab before *and* after the detail fetch, so it inherits the same race protection as `logs`. Add a full-height JSON viewer pane with Reload + Copy JSON. The drawer header's Inspect button becomes a tab switch (with an active state) rather than a modal.
2. **Maintenance = derived report + explicit actions.**
   - *Detection* is computed **client-side** from the shared snapshot (`state.containers/images/volumes/networks`) inside `useInfra.js` — no new read endpoint, always consistent with what the other tabs show, instant, and no loading/error state to fake. A threshold ("older than") drives "old stuff".
   - *Destruction* is a real server operation: `POST /api/infra/maintenance/prune` plus `DELETE` for images/volumes/networks. No fake optimistic success — failures (resource in use) surface as a warning toast. Permissions/destructiveness are covered by the existing `confirm()` flow.
3. **Layout.** The panel reuses `layout.compact` / `layout.twoCol` (measured panel width) instead of viewport breakpoints — consistent with the rest of the view, which lives in a resizable dockview panel.

**Dependencies & risks**
- `USE_MOCK = false` in the infra API module → the new endpoints must exist server-side. Mock router is kept in sync (same file, same contract) so the module stays coherent.
- `showJson` stays in use for images/volumes/networks/stacks (out of scope).
- Bulk delete is sequential per item so one "in use" resource cannot abort the whole batch.

| `src/api/modules/infra.js` | Modify — contract + prune/delete methods + mock routes |
| `src/views/infra/useInfra.js` | Modify — maintenance tab, report selector, actions, inspect tab |

| `src/views/infra/ContainersPanel.vue` | Modify — Inspect opens the drawer |
| `src/views/infra/MaintenancePanel.vue` | **Create** |
| `src/views/infra/InfraView.vue` | Modify — route + filter row |

 * @property {InfraEnvVar[]} env
 * @property {InfraMount[]}  mounts
 * @property {InfraNetworkAttachment[]} networks
 * @property {string[]} cmd
 * @property {string}  entrypoint
 * @property {InfraHealthcheck|null} healthcheck

function _fmtDur(sec) {
  if (sec == null) return '—'
  const d = Math.floor(sec / 86400), h = Math.floor((sec % 86400) / 3600), m = Math.floor((sec % 3600) / 60)
  if (d) return d + 'd ' + h + 'h'
  if (h) return h + 'h ' + m + 'm'
  if (m) return m + 'm'
  return Math.floor(sec) + 's'
}

function _applyDerived() {
  MOCK.containers.forEach((c) => {
    c.short = c.id.slice(0, 12)
    c.mem_pct = c.mem_limit ? Math.min(100, Math.round((c.mem_used / c.mem_limit) * 100)) : 0
    if (c.state === 'running' && c.started_at) {
      c.uptime_seconds = Math.max(0, Math.floor((Date.now() - new Date(c.started_at).getTime()) / 1000))
    }
    if (c.state === 'running') c.status_text = 'Up ' + _fmtDur(c.uptime_seconds)
    else if (c.state === 'restarting') c.status_text = 'Restarting (' + (c.restart_count || 1) + ')'
    else if (c.state === 'paused') c.status_text = 'Up ' + _fmtDur(c.uptime_seconds) + ' (Paused)'
    else if (c.state === 'exited') c.status_text = c.status_text || 'Exited (0)'
    else if (c.state === 'created') c.status_text = 'Created'
  })
}
_applyDerived()

function _findContainer(idOrName) {
  return MOCK.containers.find((c) => c.id === idOrName || c.name === idOrName)
}

function _hostContainers(hostId) {

function _buildSummary(hostId) {
  const host = MOCK.hosts.find((h) => h.id === hostId) || MOCK.hosts[0]
  const list = _hostContainers(hostId)
  const running = list.filter((c) => c.state === 'running')
  return {

    disk_total: host.disk_total,
    counts: {

      running: running.length,
      stopped: list.filter((c) => c.state === 'exited' || c.state === 'created').length,
      paused: list.filter((c) => c.state === 'paused').length,
      restarting: list.filter((c) => c.state === 'restarting').length,
      unhealthy: list.filter((c) => c.health === 'unhealthy').length,
      images: _activeImages(hostId).filter((i) => !i.dangling).length,
      volumes: _activeVolumes(hostId).length,
      networks: _activeNetworks(hostId).length
    }
  }
}

function _activeImages(hostId) {
  return MOCK.images.filter((i) => {
    const used = MOCK.containers.some((c) => c.host_id === hostId && c.image === i.repo + ':' + i.tag)
    return used || i.dangling
  }).map((i) => Object.assign({}, i, {
    containers: MOCK.containers.filter((c) => c.host_id === hostId && c.image === i.repo + ':' + i.tag).length
  }))
}

function _activeVolumes(hostId) {
  return MOCK.volumes
    .filter((v) => (v.host_id || 'host-local') === hostId)

    }))

function _activeNetworks(hostId) {
  return MOCK.networks
    .filter((n) => (n.host_id || 'host-local') === hostId)
    .map((n) => Object.assign({}, n, {
      containers: MOCK.containers
        .filter((c) => c.host_id === hostId && c.networks.some((cn) => cn.name === n.name))
        .map((c) => c.name)

function _buildStacks(hostId) {
  const map = {}
  _hostContainers(hostId).forEach((c) => {
    if (!c.stack) return
    map[c.stack] = map[c.stack] || { name: c.stack, host_id: hostId, services: [] }
    map[c.stack].services.push({ service: c.service, name: c.name, state: c.state, health: c.health, id: c.id })
  })
  return Object.values(map).map((s) => {
    const running = s.services.filter((x) => x.state === 'running').length
    s.status = running === s.services.length ? 'running' : running === 0 ? 'stopped' : 'degraded'
    s.running = running
    s.total = s.services.length
    s.path = '/opt/codx-junior/' + s.name + '/docker-compose.yaml'
    return s
  }).sort((a, b) => a.name.localeCompare(b.name))
}

function _genLogs(c, tail) {
  if (!c) return []
  const n = Math.min(tail || 120, 200)
  const svc = c.service || c.name
  const pool = {

         ['INFO', 'checkpoint starting: time'],
         ['INFO', 'checkpoint complete: wrote 41 buffers (0.3%)'],
         ['DEBUG', 'autovacuum: table "chats" pages: 120 removed, 480 remain']],
    cache: [['INFO', 'Background saving started by pid 42'], ['INFO', 'DB saved on disk'], ['DEBUG', 'AOF rewrite finished successfully']],
    app: [['INFO', 'chat request completed model=llama3.1 duration=1.42s tokens=812'],
          ['INFO', 'knowledge search project=codx-junior results=6'],
          ['WARN', 'llm provider slow response (>5s), retrying with fallback model'],
          ['INFO', 'websocket connected user=ada clients=3'],
          ['DEBUG', 'index watcher: 0 files changed']],
    embed: [['INFO', 'embedding batch size=32 tokens=4096'], ['DEBUG', 'model loaded: nomic-embed-text'], ['WARN', 'kv cache near capacity, evicting oldest entry']],
    proxy: [['INFO', 'router codx service=codx loadbalancer=172.18.0.4:8001'], ['INFO', 'Traefik version v3.0 starting'], ['DEBUG', 'certificate renewed domain=codx.local']],
    grafana: [['INFO', 'HTTP Server Listen address=[::]:3000'], ['INFO', 'alerting: rule evaluation completed']],

    registry: [['INFO', 'response completed http.request.method=GET uri=/v2/']],
    chromium: [['INFO', 'websockify: client connected'], ['WARN', 'healthcheck: 3 consecutive failures (unhealthy)']],
    backup: [['INFO', 'pg_dump complete size=1.2GB'], ['INFO', 'uploaded to /backup/2025-05-28.sql.gz'], ['INFO', 'retention: removed 1 old backup']]
  }
  const key = Object.keys(pool).find((k) => svc.includes(k) || (c.image || '').includes(k))
  const base = pool[key] || [['INFO', svc + ' started'],
    ['WARN', 'deprecation notice: legacy config key detected'],
    ['ERROR', 'connection refused to upstream, will retry in 5s'],
    ['INFO', 'healthy']]
  const out = []
  for (let i = n - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    const tpl = base[Math.floor(_rnd() * base.length)]
    out.push({ ts: _isoAgo(i * 1300 + Math.floor(_rnd() * 900)), level: tpl[0], msg: tpl[1] })
  }
  return out
}

function _genStats(c) {
  if (!c) return { current: {}, series: [] }
  const series = []
  let cpu = c.cpu_pct || 1
  let mem = c.mem_used || 0
  for (let i = 39; i >= 0; i--) {
    cpu = Math.max(0, cpu + (_rnd() - 0.5) * Math.max(0.4, (c.cpu_pct || 1) * 0.25))
    mem = Math.max(0, mem + (_rnd() - 0.5) * (c.mem_limit || GiB) * 0.02)
    series.push({ t: _isoAgo(MIN * i * 1.5), cpu: +cpu.toFixed(1), mem: Math.round(Math.min(mem, c.mem_limit || GiB)) })
  }
  return {
    current: {
      cpu_pct: c.cpu_pct || 0, mem_used: c.mem_used || 0, mem_limit: c.mem_limit || 0,
      net_rx: c.net_rx || 0, net_tx: c.net_tx || 0,
      block_read: c.block_read || 0, block_write: c.block_write || 0, pids: c.pids || 0
    },
    series
  }
}

function _doAction(id, action) {
  const c = _findContainer(id)
  if (!c) return null
  if (action === 'start' || action === 'restart') {
    c.state = 'running'
    if (c.health !== 'unhealthy') c.health = c.healthcheck ? 'starting' : c.health
    c.started_at = new Date().toISOString()
    c.uptime_seconds = 0
    if (action === 'restart') c.restart_count = (c.restart_count || 0) + 1
  } else if (action === 'stop' || action === 'kill') {
    c.state = 'exited'; c.health = null; c.cpu_pct = 0; c.mem_used = 0
  } else if (action === 'pause') {
    c.state = 'paused'; c.cpu_pct = 0
  } else if (action === 'unpause') {
    c.state = 'running'
  }
  c.status_text = ''
  _applyDerived()
  MOCK.events.unshift({ ts: new Date().toISOString(), type: 'container', action, actor: c.name })
  return Object.assign({}, c)
}

function _createContainer(body) {
  const c = C({

    state: 'running', health: body.healthcheck ? 'starting' : null,

    host_id: body.host_id || 'host-local', stack: body.stack || 'adhoc', service: body.name,
    ports: (body.ports || []).filter(Boolean).map((p) => ({ host: p.host, container: p.container, proto: p.proto || 'tcp', published: true })),
    cpu_pct: 0.6, mem_used: 32 * MiB, mem_limit: 512 * MiB,
    env: (body.env || []).filter(Boolean),

  MOCK.containers.push(c)
  _applyDerived()
  MOCK.events.unshift({ ts: new Date().toISOString(), type: 'container', action: 'create', actor: c.name })
  return Object.assign({}, c)
}

function _removeContainer(id) {
  const i = MOCK.containers.findIndex((x) => x.id === id || x.name === id)
  if (i < 0) return null
  const name = MOCK.containers[i].name
  MOCK.containers.splice(i, 1)
  MOCK.events.unshift({ ts: new Date().toISOString(), type: 'container', action: 'destroy', actor: name })
  return { ok: true }
}

/* -- MOCK: maintenance — single-resource removal ------------------------- */

function _removeImage(id) {
  const ix = MOCK.images.findIndex((i) => i.id === id)
  if (ix < 0) return null
  const img = MOCK.images[ix]
  const inUse = MOCK.containers.some((c) => c.image === img.repo + ':' + img.tag)
  if (inUse) throw new Error('image is used by a container')
  MOCK.images.splice(ix, 1)
  MOCK.events.unshift({ ts: new Date().toISOString(), type: 'image', action: 'destroy', actor: img.repo + ':' + img.tag })
  return { ok: true }
}

function _removeVolume(name) {
  const ix = MOCK.volumes.findIndex((v) => v.name === name)
  if (ix < 0) return null
  const inUse = MOCK.containers.some((c) => c.mounts.some((m) => m.source === name))
  if (inUse) throw new Error('volume is in use')
  MOCK.volumes.splice(ix, 1)
  MOCK.events.unshift({ ts: new Date().toISOString(), type: 'volume', action: 'destroy', actor: name })
  return { ok: true }
}

function _removeNetwork(id) {
  const ix = MOCK.networks.findIndex((n) => n.id === id || n.name === id)
  if (ix < 0) return null
  const net = MOCK.networks[ix]
  if (['host', 'none', 'bridge'].includes(net.name)) throw new Error('predefined network cannot be removed')
  const attached = MOCK.containers.some((c) => c.networks.some((cn) => cn.name === net.name))
  if (attached) throw new Error('network has active endpoints')
  MOCK.networks.splice(ix, 1)
  MOCK.events.unshift({ ts: new Date().toISOString(), type: 'network', action: 'destroy', actor: net.name })
  return { ok: true }
}

/* -- MOCK: maintenance — prune ------------------------------------------ */

function _prune(body) {
  const target = body.target
  const host = body.host_id || 'host-local'
  let removed = 0
  let reclaimed = 0

  const dropImages = () => {
    for (let i = MOCK.images.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      const img = MOCK.images[i]
      if (MOCK.containers.some((c) => c.image === img.repo + ':' + img.tag)) continue
      if (body.dangling_only && !img.dangling) continue
      reclaimed += img.size || 0
      MOCK.images.splice(i, 1)
      removed++
    }
  }
  const dropVolumes = () => {
    for (let i = MOCK.volumes.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      const v = MOCK.volumes[i]
      if (MOCK.containers.some((c) => c.mounts.some((m) => m.source === v.name))) continue
      reclaimed += v.size || 0
      MOCK.volumes.splice(i, 1)
      removed++
    }
  }
  const dropNetworks = () => {
    for (let i = MOCK.networks.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      const n = MOCK.networks[i]
      if (['host', 'none', 'bridge'].includes(n.name)) continue
      if (MOCK.containers.some((c) => c.networks.some((cn) => cn.name === n.name))) continue
      MOCK.networks.splice(i, 1)
      removed++
    }
  }

  if (target === 'images') dropImages()
  else if (target === 'volumes') dropVolumes()
  else if (target === 'networks') dropNetworks()
  // MOCK: the builder cache is not modelled as a collection — fixed figures.
  else if (target === 'build_cache') { removed = 12; reclaimed = 4.2 * GiB }
  else if (target === 'system') { dropImages(); dropVolumes(); dropNetworks(); removed += 12; reclaimed += 4.2 * GiB }
  else throw new Error('unknown prune target: ' + target)

  MOCK.events.unshift({ ts: new Date().toISOString(), type: 'system', action: 'prune', actor: target })
  return { ok: true, host_id: host, target, removed, reclaimed_bytes: Math.round(reclaimed) }
}

function _listContainers(search) {
  const host = search.get('host') || 'host-local'
  let list = _hostContainers(host)
  const st = search.get('state')
  const stack = search.get('stack')
  const term = (search.get('q') || '').toLowerCase()
  if (st && st !== 'all') list = list.filter((c) => (st === 'unhealthy' ? c.health === 'unhealthy' : c.state === st))
  if (stack && stack !== 'all') list = list.filter((c) => c.stack === stack)
  if (term) {
    list = list.filter((c) =>
      c.name.toLowerCase().includes(term) ||
      c.image.toLowerCase().includes(term) ||
      c.service.toLowerCase().includes(term) ||
      c.stack.toLowerCase().includes(term))
  }
  return { total: list.length, containers: list.map((c) => Object.assign({}, c)) }
}

// MOCK: tiny router reproducing the REST contract above
function _route(method, pathname, search, body) {
  let m
  if (method === 'GET' && pathname === '/api/infra/hosts') return { hosts: MOCK.hosts }
  if (method === 'GET' && pathname === '/api/infra/summary') return _buildSummary(search.get('host') || 'host-local')
  if (method === 'GET' && pathname === '/api/infra/containers') return _listContainers(search)

  if (method === 'GET' && (m = pathname.match(/^\/api\/infra\/containers\/([^/]+)\/logs$/))) {
    return { id: m[1], lines: _genLogs(_findContainer(m[1]), Number(search.get('tail') || 120)) }
  }
  if (method === 'GET' && (m = pathname.match(/^\/api\/infra\/containers\/([^/]+)\/stats$/))) {
    return _genStats(_findContainer(m[1]))
  }
  if (method === 'POST' && (m = pathname.match(/^\/api\/infra\/containers\/([^/]+)\/actions$/))) {
    return _doAction(m[1], body && body.action)
  }
  if (method === 'GET' && (m = pathname.match(/^\/api\/infra\/containers\/([^/]+)$/))) {
    const c = _findContainer(m[1]); return c ? Object.assign({}, c) : null
  }
  if (method === 'DELETE' && (m = pathname.match(/^\/api\/infra\/containers\/([^/]+)$/))) {
    return _removeContainer(m[1])
  }
  if (method === 'POST' && pathname === '/api/infra/containers') return _createContainer(body || {})

  if (method === 'GET' && pathname === '/api/infra/stacks') return { stacks: _buildStacks(search.get('host') || 'host-local') }
  if (method === 'GET' && pathname === '/api/infra/images') return { images: _activeImages(search.get('host') || 'host-local') }
  if (method === 'GET' && pathname === '/api/infra/volumes') return { volumes: _activeVolumes(search.get('host') || 'host-local') }
  if (method === 'GET' && pathname === '/api/infra/networks') return { networks: _activeNetworks(search.get('host') || 'host-local') }
  if (method === 'GET' && pathname === '/api/infra/events') return { events: MOCK.events.slice(0, 60) }

  if (method === 'DELETE' && (m = pathname.match(/^\/api\/infra\/images\/(.+)$/))) {
    return _removeImage(decodeURIComponent(m[1]))
  }
  if (method === 'DELETE' && (m = pathname.match(/^\/api\/infra\/volumes\/(.+)$/))) {
    return _removeVolume(decodeURIComponent(m[1]))
  }
  if (method === 'DELETE' && (m = pathname.match(/^\/api\/infra\/networks\/(.+)$/))) {
    return _removeNetwork(decodeURIComponent(m[1]))
  }
  if (method === 'POST' && pathname === '/api/infra/maintenance/prune') return _prune(body || {})

  return null
}

function _mock(method, path, body) {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    // MOCK: simulated latency so loading states are visible
    setTimeout(() => {
      try {
        const parsed = new URL(path, 'http://mock.local')
        const result = _route(method, parsed.pathname, parsed.searchParams, body)
        if (result == null) reject(new Error('infra mock: no route for ' + method + ' ' + path))
        else resolve(result)
      } catch (err) {
        reject(err)
      }
    }, 120 + Math.random() * 260)
  })
}

/* ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 * 3. MODULE — the public API surface used by the UI
 * ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

/**
 * Infrastructure module factory.
 * @param {object} API  The codx-junior API instance (see src/api/api.js).
 */
export function infraModule(API) {
  const get = (path) => (USE_MOCK ? _mock('GET', path) : API.get(path))
  const post = (path, body) => (USE_MOCK ? _mock('POST', path, body) : API.post(path, body))
  const del = (path) => (USE_MOCK ? _mock('DELETE', path) : API.delete(path))

  const slug = (id) => encodeURIComponent(id)
  const hostQs = (host) => 'host=' + encodeURIComponent(host || 'host-local')

  return {
    /** @type {boolean} true while the UI runs against in-file mock data. */
    isMock: USE_MOCK,
    /** @type {typeof INFRA_ENDPOINTS} machine-readable backend contract. */
    endpoints: INFRA_ENDPOINTS,

    /** @returns {Promise<{hosts: import('./infra').InfraHost[]}>} */
    hosts: () => get('/api/infra/hosts'),

    /** @returns {Promise<object>} host gauges + counts */
    summary: (host = 'host-local') => get('/api/infra/summary?' + hostQs(host)),

    /**
     * @param {{host?:string,state?:string,stack?:string,q?:string}} params
     * @returns {Promise<{total:number, containers:any[]}>}
     */
    containers: (params = {}) => {
      const q = new URLSearchParams()
      if (params.host) q.set('host', params.host)
      if (params.state) q.set('state', params.state)
      if (params.stack) q.set('stack', params.stack)
      if (params.q) q.set('q', params.q)
      const qs = q.toString()
      return get('/api/infra/containers' + (qs ? '?' + qs : ''))
    },

    container: (id) => get('/api/infra/containers/' + slug(id)),
    logs: (id, tail = 120) => get('/api/infra/containers/' + slug(id) + '/logs?tail=' + tail),
    stats: (id) => get('/api/infra/containers/' + slug(id) + '/stats'),

    /** @param {'start'|'stop'|'restart'|'pause'|'unpause'|'kill'} action */
    action: (id, action) => post('/api/infra/containers/' + slug(id) + '/actions', { action }),

    /** @param {{name:string,image:string,ports?:any[],env?:any[],cmd?:string,stack?:string}} payload */
    create: (payload) => post('/api/infra/containers', payload),
    remove: (id) => del('/api/infra/containers/' + slug(id)),

    stacks: (host = 'host-local') => get('/api/infra/stacks?' + hostQs(host)),
    images: (host = 'host-local') => get('/api/infra/images?' + hostQs(host)),
    volumes: (host = 'host-local') => get('/api/infra/volumes?' + hostQs(host)),
    networks: (host = 'host-local') => get('/api/infra/networks?' + hostQs(host)),
    events: (host = 'host-local') => get('/api/infra/events?' + hostQs(host)),

    /* ── Maintenance ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

    /** Remove a single image. Rejects while a container still uses it. */
    removeImage: (id) => del('/api/infra/images/' + slug(id)),
    /** Remove a single volume. Rejects while a container mounts it. */
    removeVolume: (name) => del('/api/infra/volumes/' + slug(name)),
    /** Remove a single network. Rejects while it has endpoints. */
    removeNetwork: (id) => del('/api/infra/networks/' + slug(id)),

    /**
     * Prune one resource class.
     * @param {{target:'images'|'volumes'|'networks'|'build_cache'|'system',
     *          older_than_days?:number|null, dangling_only?:boolean, host_id?:string}} payload
     * @returns {Promise<{ok:boolean, removed:number, reclaimed_bytes:number}>}
     */
    prune: (payload = {}) => post('/api/infra/maintenance/prune', payload)
  }
}
